title: The Lighthouse Paint Crew
story: Thimble Point Light turns 150 this year, so on a bright May Saturday four volunteers climbed out to the Point with drop cloths to make it look the part. Each painted one part of the lighthouse with one kind of tool, while the old Keeper's Lamp waited safely under a sheet. Lena, white gloves on, wants the work log exactly right before the big birthday night. Who painted what, and with which tool?

cats.label: Tool
cats.either: worked with either the {a} or the {b}
cats.nor: worked with neither the {a} nor the {b}

texts: The volunteer with the wide brush is either Faye or Jonah.
The painter of the stairs is either Ruben or Faye.
Of the volunteer with the roller and the volunteer with the small brush, one painted the door and the other painted the stairs.
Jonah painted either the shutters or the railing.
The painter of the shutters did not work with the wide brush.
The volunteer with the roller painted neither the door nor the railing.
The painter of the railing is neither Jonah nor Ruben.

trace.text: Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 4 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Jonah must go with the shutters: clue 4 rules out the door; clue 7 rules out the railing; clue 2 rules out the stairs.
The wide brush must go with Faye: clue 1 rules out Teddy and Ruben; Jonah is already ruled out for the shutters.
Clue 3 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The door must go with the small brush: clue 6 rules out the roller; clue 3 rules out the wide brush and the sponge.
The stairs must go with the roller: clue 3 rules out the wide brush and the sponge; the small brush already goes with the door.
The shutters must go with the sponge: clue 3 rules out the roller and the small brush; clue 5 rules out the wide brush.
The railing must go with the wide brush: clue 6 rules out the roller; clue 3 rules out the small brush; the sponge already goes with the shutters.
Jonah goes with the shutters, so Jonah also goes with the sponge.
Faye goes with the wide brush, so Faye also goes with the railing.
Teddy must go with the door: clue 2 rules out the stairs; the other choices are already taken.
Ruben must go with the stairs: clue 7 rules out the railing; the other choices are already taken.
The small brush goes with the door, so the small brush also goes with Teddy.
Ruben must go with the roller: clue 1 rules out the wide brush; the other choices are already taken.
